schema.text: How comfortable are you using navigation or map apps for travel?
schema.help: Navigation apps show maps and directions, for example Google Maps or Moovit.

en.#How comfortable are you using navigatio: How comfortable are you using navigation or map apps for travel?
en.#Navigation apps show maps and direction: Navigation apps show maps and directions, for example Google Maps or Moovit.

it.#How comfortable are you using navigatio: Quanto ti senti a tuo agio nell'utilizzare app di navigazione o mappe per i tuoi spostamenti?
it.#Navigation apps show maps and direction: Le app di navigazione mostrano mappe e indicazioni, ad esempio Google Maps o Moovit.
it.#Neither comfortable nor uncomfortable: Né a mio agio né a disagio

fr.#How comfortable are you using navigatio: Êtes-vous à l’aise pour utiliser des applications de navigation ou de cartes pendant vos déplacements ?
fr.#Navigation apps show maps and direction: Les applications de navigation affichent des cartes et des itinéraires, par exemple Google Maps ou Moovit.
fr.#Neither comfortable nor uncomfortable: Ni à l’aise ni mal à l’aise

de.#How comfortable are you using navigatio: Wie wohl fühlen Sie sich bei der Nutzung von Navigations- oder Karten-Apps für Ihre Wege?
de.#Navigation apps show maps and direction: Navigations-Apps zeigen Karten und Wegbeschreibungen, zum Beispiel Google Maps oder Moovit.

tr.#How comfortable are you using navigatio: Yolculuklarınızda navigasyon veya harita uygulamalarını kullanırken kendinizi ne kadar rahat hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#Navigation apps show maps and direction: Navigasyon uygulamaları harita ve yol tarifi gösterir; örneğin Google Maps veya Moovit.

fa.#How comfortable are you using navigatio: هنگام استفاده از برنامه‌های مسیریابی یا نقشه برای سفر چقدر احساس راحتی می‌کنید؟
fa.#Navigation apps show maps and direction: اپلیکیشن‌های مسیریابی نقشه و مسیر را نشان می‌دهند، مانند Google Maps یا Moovit.

hu.#How comfortable are you using navigatio: Mennyire érzi magát kényelmesen navigációs vagy térképes alkalmazások használatakor?
hu.#Navigation apps show maps and direction: A navigációs alkalmazások térképet és útvonalat mutatnak, például a Google Maps vagy a Moovit.

ar.#How comfortable are you using navigatio: ما مدى راحتك في استخدام تطبيقات الملاحة أو الخرائط أثناء التنقل؟
ar.#Navigation apps show maps and direction: تعرض تطبيقات الملاحة الخرائط والاتجاهات، مثل Google Maps أو Moovit.
